scene.speaker: tomas
scene.bubble: Farm trip! Moo, baa, quack — it's like a big animal song. Pip is talking to the ducks!
scene.intro: Farm trip! The bus stops and Tomás runs to the animals. It is a cow — moo! It is a duck — quack! It is a sheep, it is a horse, it is a very pink pig in the mud. The grass is wet and everybody's shoes are dirty. Pip is talking to the hens, and the hens answer him! It is a hen, says Tomás, laughing. What animals live on a farm? Come and hear them all!

words.clue: Big, black and white. It gives milk.
It is woolly and says baa.
Pink and round. It loves mud!

activities.title: Match the animal with its sound.
Listen on the farm. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Tomás (en la granja) y Freya (contando animales).
data.script: Tomas: Look! Three cows under the tree. … Freya: And five little ducks in the water! … Tomas: The pig is sleeping in the mud. So happy! … Freya: The hens have got eggs. One, two… six eggs! … Tomas: Can I ride the horse? It's brown and very big. … Freya: And Pip is talking to the ducks. Quack quack, Pip! … Tomas: Best trip ever. Goodbye, farm!

outcomes.puede: Follow classroom instructions; identify familiar words in songs and short spoken sentences.
Greet; say name, age, colours; name objects; answer yes/no questions.
Recognise all 26 letters; match words to pictures (family, food, animals, body).
Write own name; trace and copy words; label pictures (3–5 words).
~150 productive words; Verb to be, can, like + noun, imperatives, this/that.
